title: Guy Banister reports UFO sightings to Hoover under special mission X
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Guy Banister reports UFO sightings to Hoover under special mission X, about 1947 at Pacific Northwest, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> guy Banister's job is reporting on UFO sightings back to Hoover

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about secret history, says that in 1947 in the Pacific Northwest of the United States, a man named Guy Banister had the job of reporting UFO sightings back to J. Edgar Hoover, the head of the FBI, under what is described as a special mission. If true, it would mean the FBI was quietly tracking UFO reports from the very start of the modern sightings.
